pages.title: The First Soul Fire
pages.text: A small reserve of both processed materials lets the player try first companions without repeating a long preparation step.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Place a Great Chalice directly above the Soul Furnace and fill it with Essence: the full Chalice empties automatically and adds one furnace charge. Use a separate Chalice for filling Grails or the furnace takes the fill first. Follow actual recipe costs; configuration-enabled constant power does not
